description: Search the charities that take gifts on Mindful Give by name. Returns each match with its giving page URL to hand to the donor. This tool only looks charities up and returns a link: it never takes a payment. The donor completes the gift themselves on the charity's giving page, and the charity issues the official tax receipt.

limit.description: How many charities to return (1-10, default 5).

query.description: Part of the charity's name, e.g. "Sacred Heart".

name: find_charities
title: Find charities
